prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop macOS application composition comp for ADE, an agentic development workbench. This is a real interface layout, not a poster or marketing image. Landscape 1586x992. Surface: Agents conversation workbench. Structure: narrow labeled navigation sidebar at left with Projects, Editor, Agents, Work, Knowledge, Version control; a compact project explorer below; a slim top context bar showing project and branch; a sessions rail beside the main content; a large central conversation timeline with readable realistic developer/agent messages, timestamps, tool activity and changed-file evidence inline; a calm composer at the bottom; a native terminal dock remains visible as a shallow bottom strip. Make the central conversation unmistakably dominant, with generous whitespace and clear reading rhythm. Use the approved direction “Sala de Evidencia”: light-first warm paper-white canvas, graphite ink, soft gray structural lines, restrained cobalt-blue action accent, semantic green/amber/red and agent violet; system sans plus monospace only for paths/status. Use softened 8px geometry, no sharp cards, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no decorative illustration. The supplied screenshot is only a reference for current ADE chrome/component content; carry over its technical clarity but replace the rigid angular visual language. Show an original, calm, precise macOS workbench with strong hierarchy and excellent legibility. Do not make it look like a generic AI-generated web dashboard, and do not invent a hero banner.
